gloss: to be preoccupied with, to be absorbed in

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: かまけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be preoccupied with, to be absorbed in
definitions.explanation: To be so focused on one thing that other responsibilities or tasks are neglected. Almost always used with に to mark what one is preoccupied with, and carries a negative nuance of neglecting something else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{忙|いそが}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまけて、⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy that I forgot to get in touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまけて、⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I was so caught up in daily life that I had forgotten to pursue my dreams.

notes:
CONJUGATION (ichidan):
- Negative: かまけない
- Te-form: かまけて
- Past: かまけた

COMMON PATTERNS:
Almost always used as ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまけて (preoccupied with ~). The ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle marks the thing one is absorbed in.

USAGE:
Carries a negative connotation — being so focused on one thing that something else (often more important) is neglected. Not used to describe positive concentration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまける: to be preoccupied with work
- {忙|いそが}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまける: to be caught up in busyness
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまける: to be absorbed in daily routine
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまける: to be caught up in having fun
